plugin_registry.description: Installed Codex plugins with lane assignment and policy compliance.

fields.policy_compliant: boolean — true when channel satisfies the OpenAI-first policy

plugin_registry.sync_rule: Regenerate from the Codex plugin list export; never hand-edit records.

plugin_lanes.description: Operational lanes grouping plugins by build surface.
plugin_lanes.sync_rule: Derived from plugin_registry aggregation once live; static counts until then.

repositories.description: Canonical repository state and consolidated source repositories.

fields.history_preserved: boolean — full history exists under sources/<repo>/<branch> refs

repositories.sync_rule: Update when repositories are consolidated, archived, or deleted.

source_branches.description: Full-history source refs preserved inside SEIS.

fields.verified: boolean — ref pushed and listed in sources/README.md

source_branches.sync_rule: Append-only; refs are recovery anchors and must not be rewritten.

workspace_links.description: Google Workspace operating artifacts linked into SEIS.
workspace_links.sync_rule: Update this model whenever Drive or Calendar artifacts change.

governance_gates.description: Operating gates the cockpit footer renders.
governance_gates.sync_rule: Gate state changes require a decision record entry before edit.

consumer_contract.live_consumer: apps/web cockpit panels query Convex tables with the same entity shapes
consumer_contract.rule: Panel shapes in the cockpit must keep working unchanged when the data source switches from the static bundle to live backend queries.
